check_is_tensor: check if an input is a Torch tensor or CUDALongTensor using is_tensor
check_is_float_tensor: check if a tensor is a float type (float16, float32, float64) using is_float_tensor
check_is_int_tensor: check if a tensor is an int type (uint8, int8, int16, int32, int64) using is_int_tensor
check_is_type_tensor: check if a tensor elements match specific dtype types using _is_type_tensor
review_tensor_type_checking: review the tensor type-checking helper functions for float, int, and base tensor detection
